Method of Attack: Distributing banking Trojan payloads via malspam emails camouflaged as messages from German federal authorities
Discoverer: BSI (Federal Office for Security in Information Technology, Germany)
Attack Vector: Malspam emails with malicious attachments or links, sent as replies in existing email conversations
Indicators of Compromise: Spam emails sent on behalf of several federal agencies
Use of 1,875 unique domains covering more than 400 TLDs
C2 servers delivering responses to POST requests around 3PM EST on Aug 21, 2019
